body: When a module set is condemned, the replacement module, immobilizer, ignition switch, steering lock, key, and door cylinder must all come from the same running donor, and the part-number index must match exactly. A wrong-index donor was rejected and refunded.
title: Matched-set rule (verified)

body: After a clutch-circuit oil change only, the car runs flawlessly even fully hot. Final gates still open and not claimed done: a fully-hot brake-release creep test in Drive and Reverse, and a clean rescan.
title: Fluid-fix stakes (verified portion)

body: A +3.02 mg per stroke deviation stayed on cylinder 4 after the injector swap, so the fault follows the cylinder, not the injector. Condemn the cylinder side, not the first suspect.
title: Fault-follows-cylinder (verified)
